title: How to feedback that needs you waits at the top of Clients
why: Coach Milan 19 November 20:26 to 20:30: can feedback from a beta tester trigger a notification, as Clients has for a check-in or a new beta tester application? Yes.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 19 November 2026, 20:26. DT329 (0.3.166) gave How to the faces and a line of your own; the feedback sits in How to: your testers, far down on Clients.
opportunity.job: As Coach Milan, see at once when a beta tester says a way did not work or went badly, so that I answer while it is fresh.
opportunity.kind: Missing: nothing tells me that new feedback came; I see it only if I scroll down to the testers.
opportunity.why_now: The beta round runs now, and 0.3.166 asks every tester how it went.

problem: A beta tester taps Didn't work, or gives a sad face with a line. It reaches the database, and it shows in How to: your testers, near the bottom of Clients. Nothing counts it and nothing points to it, unlike a beta application or a check-in, which wait at the top in Waiting for you and count in the badge on Clients.
story: When a beta tester tells me a way did not work or went badly, I want it to wait for me at the top of Clients, so that I see it without looking for it.

ac.title: It waits at the top
ac.text: Given a tester marked Didn't work on Scan a pack from any screen, when I open Clients, then Waiting for you has a row: the tester's first name and the situation, Didn't work, their line, How to and the day, after the beta applications.

ac.title: What counts
ac.text: Given the testers' marks, when Waiting for you is made, then every Didn't work has a row, and every I did it with face 1 or 2, or with words; I did it with face 3, 4 or 5 and no words has no row and counts only in How to: your testers.

ac.title: The face in the row
ac.text: Given a row for I did it, when I read it, then it shows the face in its colour, n of 5, and the line.

ac.title: It counts
ac.text: Given two rows of feedback and one beta application, when I look at Clients, then Waiting for you says the full count, and the badge on Clients counts them too.

ac.title: A tap opens the tester
ac.text: Given a row, when I tap it, then that tester's How to opens on its own, with every situation, the day, the face and their line, and ‹ Clients takes me back.

ac.title: Opened, it leaves
ac.text: Given I opened a row, when I am back on Clients, then that row is gone and the counts are one less; it comes back only when that tester marks the same situation again.

ac.title: Only for Coach Milan
ac.text: Given any other account, coaches and the coach demo included, when it opens Clients, then no row of How to feedback is there.

ac.title: In three languages
ac.text: Given the new lines, when the app is in Serbian or German, then each shows in that language.

now: Waiting for you holds beta applications and what clients sent; How to feedback sits only in How to: your testers, near the bottom of Clients, and counts nowhere.
proposed: Feedback that needs you, every Didn't work and every sad face or line, is a row in Waiting for you after the applications, counted in its title and in the badge on Clients. A tap opens that tester's How to on its own; opened, the row leaves.
decision: Open. Drawn for Coach Milan's Go.
details: The pictures on this board are the real app in the coach demo: today's 0.3.166, and a scratch build of it with the rows, not committed. The testers Ana and Bo and their lines are made up.
A row is kept as seen on this phone, as the other rows of Waiting for you; a new mark on the same situation makes a new row.
No email or push to the phone: the app counts it, as it counts a beta application.
